description: This file defines the Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) classes and interfaces for representing SQL statements and expressions within the OrchardCore project, specifically for SQL query parsing and analysis.

classes.name: StatementList
classes.description: Represents a list of SQL statements.

classes.name: StatementLine
classes.description: Represents a line of SQL statements, potentially including UNION statements.

classes.name: UnionStatement
classes.description: Represents a SQL UNION statement, optionally with a UNION ALL clause.

classes.name: UnionClause
classes.description: Specifies whether the UNION is ALL or DISTINCT.

classes.name: Statement
classes.description: Represents a SQL statement, possibly with a WITH clause.

classes.name: WithClause
classes.description: Represents a WITH clause containing common table expressions (CTEs).

classes.name: CommonTableExpression
classes.description: Defines a CTE with a name, optional column names, and a query.

classes.name: SelectStatement
classes.description: Represents a SELECT SQL statement with various clauses like WHERE, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, etc.

classes.name: SelectRestriction
classes.description: Enumeration for SELECT restrictions: NONE, ALL, DISTINCT.

classes.name: ColumnItem
classes.description: Represents a column in the SELECT list, with optional alias.

classes.name: ColumnSource
classes.description: Abstract base class for different column sources in SELECT statements.

classes.name: ColumnSourceIdentifier
classes.description: Column source based on an identifier.

classes.name: ColumnSourceValue
classes.description: Column source based on an expression value.

classes.name: ColumnSourceFunction
classes.description: Column source based on a function call, with optional OVER clause.

classes.name: FromClause
classes.description: Represents the FROM clause with table sources and joins.

classes.name: TableSource
classes.description: Abstract base class for table sources.

classes.name: TableSourceItem
classes.description: Represents a table source identified by a name, with optional alias.

classes.name: TableSourceSubQuery
classes.description: Represents a subquery used as a table source, with an alias.

classes.name: JoinStatement
classes.description: Represents a JOIN clause with join type, tables, and conditions.

classes.name: JoinKind
classes.description: Enumeration for join types: None, Inner, Left, Right.

classes.name: WhereClause
classes.description: Represents the WHERE clause with an expression.

classes.name: GroupByClause
classes.description: Represents the GROUP BY clause with columns.

classes.name: HavingClause
classes.description: Represents the HAVING clause with an expression.

classes.name: OrderByClause
classes.description: Represents the ORDER BY clause with items.

classes.name: OrderByItem
classes.description: Represents an item in ORDER BY with identifier, optional arguments, and direction.

classes.name: OrderDirection
classes.description: Enumeration for ordering: NotSpecified, Asc, Desc.

classes.name: LimitClause
classes.description: Represents the LIMIT clause with an expression.

classes.name: OffsetClause
classes.description: Represents the OFFSET clause with an expression.

classes.name: OverClause
classes.description: Represents an OVER clause for window functions, with optional PARTITION BY and ORDER BY.

classes.name: PartitionByClause
classes.description: Represents PARTITION BY clause with columns.

classes.name: Expression
classes.description: Abstract base class for SQL expressions.

classes.name: BinaryExpression
classes.description: Represents a binary operation between two expressions.

classes.name: BinaryOperator
classes.description: Enumeration of binary operators (arithmetic, comparison, logical, bitwise).

classes.name: UnaryExpression
classes.description: Represents a unary operation on an expression.

classes.name: UnaryOperator
classes.description: Enumeration of unary operators: Not, Plus, Minus, BitwiseNot.

classes.name: BetweenExpression
classes.description: Represents a BETWEEN expression with lower and upper bounds.

classes.name: InExpression
classes.description: Represents an IN expression with a list of values.

classes.name: IdentifierExpression
classes.description: Expression based on an identifier.

classes.name: LiteralExpression
classes.description: Expression representing a literal value of generic type.

classes.name: FunctionCall
classes.description: Represents a function call with name and arguments.

classes.name: FunctionArguments
classes.description: Abstract base class for function call arguments.

classes.name: EmptyArguments
classes.description: Singleton representing no arguments.

classes.name: StarArgument
classes.description: Singleton representing '*' argument.

classes.name: SelectStatementArgument
classes.description: Arguments containing a nested SELECT statement.

classes.name: ExpressionListArguments
classes.description: Arguments containing a list of expressions.

classes.name: TupleExpression
classes.description: Expression containing a tuple of expressions.

classes.name: ParenthesizedSelectStatement
classes.description: Expression wrapping a SELECT statement in parentheses.

classes.name: ParameterExpression
classes.description: Expression representing a parameter with optional default value.

classes.name: Identifier
classes.description: Represents an SQL identifier, possibly qualified with parts.
